import { defineTable, col } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";

export const usStates = defineTable("us_states", {
    columns: {
        stateId: col.smallint().primaryKey(),
        stateName: col.varchar(100),
        stateAbbr: col.varchar(2),
        stateRegion: col.varchar(50)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
